messages:
marie: Quick design review: proposing a compact floating mini-toolbar for streaming in the playground. Items: Stop (primary), small token counter, prompt-library quick-insert. Figma: https://redwood.design/mini-toolbar-compact

ash: Placement? needs to avoid suggestion overlays.

marie: Desktop-first, bottom-right above composer. On narrow screens collapse to single icon. If suggestions open, nudge left or float above.

sam: Dev note: debounce token updates to ~250ms to avoid reflow. Stop = cancel request. Regenerate should be hidden under menu to avoid accidental taps.

ben: Show "+N tokens" on prompt insert hover/focus so users know cost. Tooltip for keyboard users.

kai: A11y: streaming area -> aria-live="polite"; token meter needs aria-label (e.g. "tokens: 120"); toolbar must be in tab order and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

a11y-bot: Checklist: keyboard-only flows, NVDA/VoiceOver with aria-live, contrast check for token meter.

marie: Microcopy: Stop tooltip "Stop — keep partial"; Regenerate tooltip "Regenerate — restart". For regenerate action: replace content + show toast "Response replaced — Undo".

ash: Add subtle fade+lift animation, reduced motion honored.

ben: Token meter modes: collapsed (dot+num), compact (bar+num default), expanded (sparkline).

kai: Esc should stop stream and return focus to composer, confirm no shortcut conflicts.

marie: Action items: ash update comps for densities; sam prototype debounce + Esc; ben spec insert token deltas + toast copy; kai run quick a11y pass. Will follow up in design sync.
